Scenario: Review Focus #2 (upstream SSE shape drift). An unknown event type
("mystery_event_v9") arrives mid-turn. The parser must NOT interrupt the
stream: the frame is surfaced as a "raw" event and the turn still completes
with the assembled text "ok".
